title: The last delivery
context: An original fictional visual vignette; no historical event is asserted.
drawing: Flat color animation with soft closed silhouettes. People have oversized rounded heads, compact solid trunks, and broad rounded arm and leg shapes that carry visible mass. Small paddle-shaped hands and blunt feet finish the silhouette. Two upright dark pill marks are the only facial marks: no mouth, nose, brows, pupils or eye shine. Clothing covers the body normally, with no anatomy visible through fabric. Read emotion from posture, head angle and pauses. Use quiet edges and limited shading; avoid glossy toy surfaces and mechanical additions.

cast.lead: Pip is an adult cartoon messenger with a white oval face, two dark upright pill eyes, a compact solid body and broad charcoal limbs. A smooth red knitted cap with no bobble covers the head. A yellow short-sleeve tee and dark charcoal shorts wrap the torso and hips. Charcoal paddle hands and rounded dark shoes complete the outfit. Pip has no drawn nose, mouth or eyebrows. Retain these colors and garment cuts throughout.

props.item: One sealed mint-green envelope with an unmarked cream circular seal.

exclude: Hairline arms or legs, empty ring heads, extra facial marks, cloned people or objects, anatomy showing through clothing, unrequested lettering, watermarks and brand marks.

shots.setting: A quiet colored street at dusk, with warm windows, muted blue distance and a low wooden bench. No studio grid or floating interface appears. The flat character stands on the pavement.

item.place: flat on the low wooden bench

beats.action: A vertical medium view places Pip near the bench, with the street receding behind. Pip takes one step closer.
Pip grips the envelope edge with the right hand and lifts it away; the bench is left empty.
Pip holds the envelope at chest height and turns the whole body toward the street, keeping both feet attached.
